_comment: Intrepid's checklists, condensed from Apollo 11's (data/missions/apollo_11/lm_checklists.json) for Apollo 12's flight: DOI, powered descent with the ground's landing site update (Noun 69) and the redesignation onto the Surveyor crater, the surface stay, the liftoff and the rendezvous [adapted for this simulator]. Keys as in checklists.json: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO; the switches are on Intrepid's HUD and in its cabin, and the PAD buttons on the HUD and the wrist menu. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/lm_controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for; it opens as the commander boards in one. LGC MODE FREE between burns until the rendezvous, where P20 keeps AUTO for its tracking attitude.

steps.text: Yankee Clipper: CMC MODE - FREE, then UNDOCK on GO for undocking
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to DOI
Mission Control: the DOI PAD (UPLINK ACTY), or DOI to ask for it
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
V37E 52E - P52 IMU realign after undocking: V22E 3E option 3 (REFSMMAT), PRO; at V50N25 00015 PRO for the LGC's pair of stars, or ENTER to load your own at V01N70 (V21E, the detent and the star, E)
Each star: PRO at V01N70; LGC MODE - AUTO, PRO at V50N18 to turn to it, ENTER when V50N18 comes back; PRO at V01N71
At the AOT (O): on the ACA put the star on the Y-line, MARK Y, and on the X-line, MARK X; PRO. The second star as the first
V06N05 star angle difference: PRO; V06N93 torquing angles: PRO; ENTER at V50N25 00014 for P00
LGC MODE - FREE
Houston: GO for DOI
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 DPS Thrusting, TIG-15 min
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
ENG ARM - DES
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - DPS cutoff
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to PDI
Mission Control: the PDI PAD and a state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 63E - P63 Braking, TIG-10 min
Verify TIG (V06N33), PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to the PDI attitude
ENG ARM - DES
Houston: GO for powered descent
At TIG-5 s V99N68 flashing: PRO for ignition
Houston: Noun 69, the site's move downrange; V21N69E, R1 as read (+/-, ft), E
V57E: landing radar updates (ALT and VEL lights out)
High gate: P64, the LPD on the window (V16N64): redesignate onto the Surveyor crater
P65 lands, or ROD clicks fly P66, to CONTACT LIGHT
Touchdown: P68 (V06N43)
ENG ARM - OFF
PRO: P00
Houston: STAY for T1
Houston: STAY for T3
Mission Control: the ascent PAD and Yankee Clipper's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 57E - P57 lunar surface align, half an hour before the liftoff: V22E 4E option 4 (the landing site), PRO; PRO at V06N34 (TALIGN: the liftoff)
V05N06: V22E 3E technique 3 (gravity and a star), PRO; the platform turns to read gravity, then PRO at V06N04
V06N22: PRO for the coarse align; V01N70: V21E the star, ENTER, PRO; PRO at V06N79 (the detent R59 finds it in); PRO at V01N71

At the AOT (O): DETENT to N79's; MARK Y; turn the reticle (, and .) till the Y-line crosses the star, V21E its counter (the cursor), ENTER; on till the spiral crosses it, V22E the counter (the spiral), ENTER; PRO
V06N05: PRO; V06N93: PRO; ENTER at V50N25 00014 for P00
V37E 12E - P12 Powered Ascent
Verify TIG (V06N33), PRO
Verify targets and crossrange (V06N76), PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
Houston: go to cast off on this rev
At TIG-5 s V99N74 flashing: ABORT STAGE
ENG ARM - ASC
PRO: liftoff
Monitor V16N94 to insertion, V16N85
ENG ARM - OFF
PRO: P00
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to CSI

checklists.title: Rendezvous and docking (P20, P32 to P35)

steps.text: Mission Control: the CSI PAD and Yankee Clipper's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 52E - P52 IMU realign after insertion: V22E 3E option 3 (REFSMMAT), PRO; at V50N25 00015 PRO for the LGC's pair of stars, or ENTER to load your own at V01N70 (V21E, the detent and the star, E)
Each star: PRO at V01N70; LGC MODE - AUTO, PRO at V50N18 to turn to it, ENTER when V50N18 comes back; PRO at V01N71
At the AOT (O): on the ACA put the star on the Y-line, MARK Y, and on the X-line, MARK X; PRO. The second star as the first
V06N05 star angle difference: PRO; V06N93 torquing angles: PRO; ENTER at V50N25 00014 for P00
RNDZ RADAR - LGC
LGC MODE - AUTO
V95E: no state vector update yet; V67E: at V06N99 load the W matrix, V25N99E +10000E +00100E +00015E, then PRO
V37E 20E - P20: PRO at V50N18 for the turn onto Yankee Clipper; the radar designates and locks on
V50N72: NO TRACK out, the main lobe (SIGNAL STRENGTH): PRO
V80E: the marks update Intrepid's state vector (V16N54)
V37E 32E - P32 CSI, TIG-25 min: PRO on N11, N55 and N37; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO; V16N45 the marks
At 10 marks V32E, PRO on N75 and N81; 12 min before TIG V32E again, then PRO at N45: the final computation
V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min: ENTER at V50N18 to burn where Intrepid is, +Z on Yankee Clipper; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
V37E 33E - P33 CDH: PRO on N13; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO
At 4 marks V67E: load V25N99E +02000E +00020E +00005E, then PRO
V32E at 3 and at 10 marks; 12 min before TIG V32E, then PRO at N45: the final computation
V37E 41E - P41 for CDH, TIG-10 min: ENTER at V50N18; V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
V37E 34E - P34 TPI, TIG-30 min: PRO on N55; check N37, PRO; N58, PRO; N81, PRO
At 4 marks V93E: the W matrix anew
V32E at 3 and at 10 marks; 12 min before TIG V32E, PRO on N37, then PRO at N45: the final computation
V37E 41E - P41 for TPI, TIG-10 min: ENTER at V50N18; V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
V93E before the first mark
V37E 35E - P35 first midcourse at once: PRO on N81; V16N45 the marks weigh in
10 min after TPI V32E, PRO on N81, then PRO at N45: the final computation, TIG 5 min on
V37E 41E - P41; ENTER at V50N18; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
V93E before the first mark
V37E 35E - P35 second midcourse at once: PRO on N81; V16N45 the marks weigh in
25 min after TPI V32E, PRO on N81, then PRO at N45: the final computation, TIG 5 min on
V37E 41E - P41; ENTER at V50N18; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
Inside 18,000 ft: V56E, P20 ends; RNDZ RADAR - AUTO TRACK for the tapes
Braking by the gates on the TTCA: stop 40 m from Yankee Clipper
Face Yankee Clipper with Intrepid's +X; L: Yankee Clipper docks
